verdict.rationale: Restate's ctx.run wraps arbitrary steps with automatic retries, configurable backoff/retry policies, and terminal errors to bypass retries, plus durable timers/timeouts, all without manual try/catch scaffolding (restate-docs-18, restate-docs-19, restate-docs-22, restate-docs-5, restate-docs-15). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the retry/backoff configuration specifically (community evidence is general product sentiment, not focused on retry policy behavior), and no explicit example of a configured failure-policy edge case in the evidence pack.
